user.title: AI Trainer
user.description: A Hebrew WhatsApp coach for food, water and exercise. Messages received by the WhatsApp bot create users automatically and start onboarding.

data_description.api_key: Optional. You can add or change it later in the AI Trainer panel.
data_description.model: Leave empty to use the provider default.
data_description.whatsapp_account: Only needed when several WhatsApp accounts are configured.
data_description.daily_time: Local Home Assistant time, for example 08:00.

init.title: AI Trainer settings
init.description: Choose a section to edit. Changes are stored in the config entry.

ai.title: AI provider
ai.description: Select the provider, model and API key. The key is stored in the Home Assistant config entry and is never shown again.

data_description.model: Leave empty to use the provider default. Ollama uses a local model name.
data_description.api_key: Leave blank to keep the current key.
data_description.base_url: For Ollama and OpenAI-compatible servers. Example: http://homeassistant.local:11434
data_description.temperature: 0 is focused, 1 is creative. 0.5-0.8 works well for coaching.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum length of one AI reply.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: AI Trainer uses the FaserF/ha-whatsapp integration. Keep the default service unless you renamed it.

data_description.allow_groups: When disabled, group messages are ignored.
data_description.allowed_numbers: Optional allow-list. Leave empty to accept every number. Comma separated with country code.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: All times use the Home Assistant timezone.

data_description.max_users: New WhatsApp contacts above this limit are rejected.
data_description.min_ai_interval: Smooths bursts of messages. 1-3 seconds is usually enough.

prompt.title: Coach persona
prompt.description: The coach always speaks Hebrew. Use the extra instructions for tone, food preferences or house rules.

error.invalid_times: One of the times is not valid HH:MM.

whatsapp_missing.title: WhatsApp integration is required
whatsapp_missing.description: AI Trainer sends messages through FaserF/ha-whatsapp. Install and configure the WhatsApp integration, then reload AI Trainer. Until then the bot cannot send or receive messages.

send_daily_plan.name: Send daily plan
send_daily_plan.description: Generate today's food, water and workout plan and send it by WhatsApp.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a manual WhatsApp message to a registered user.

ask.name: Ask the coach
ask.description: Process a prompt through the bot pipeline as if the user wrote it.

reset_user.name: Reset user
reset_user.description: Clear a user's profile and restart onboarding.
